parameters.name: Content
parameters.description: The template content. The content is in JSON or YAML format and can be up to 64 KB in size.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The tag keys and values. You can specify 1 to 20 key-value pairs.

parameters.name: TemplateName
parameters.description: The template name. The name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_), and can be up to 200 characters in length. The name cannot start with ALIYUN, ACS, ALIBABA, or ALICLOUD.
